title.en: Where does commercial placement start in the catalogue?
title.zh: 商业浇筑在目录里从哪里开始？

description.en: The commercial sentence starts on Electric 20 and continues through the larger electric trailer pumps. It is not printed on the rural compact rows.
description.zh: 商业浇筑这句话从电动20开始，并延续到更大的电动拖泵。农村紧凑行没有印这句话。

h1.en: Where does commercial placement start in the catalogue?
h1.zh: 商业浇筑在目录里从哪里开始？

directAnswer.en: At Electric 20, if the pipe is inside 120 m / 40 m, the stone is 1–2 cm and the site can feed 22 kW. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai repeats “building and commercial concrete placement” on Electric 20, 30, 40, 50, the low-pressure 40 and 60, and HBT80-16. Electric 60 adds the high-rise phrase. Electric 80 adds high-rise and long-distance pumping. The rural models do not use the commercial sentence.
directAnswer.zh: 从电动20开始，前提是管路在 120 m / 40 m 内、石子是 1–2 cm、现场能供 22 kW。邢台河北品锦机械在电动20、30、40、50、低压40、低压60和 HBT80-16 上重复了“建筑与商业混凝土浇筑”。电动60加上高层这句话。电动80加上高层与长距离泵送。农村型号没有使用商业这句话。

heading.en: Do not dress a rural pump as a commercial one
heading.zh: 不要把农村泵写成商业泵

body.en: Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, the rural diesel and the 4100 print rural self-built houses, small sites and secondary structure. Their outputs run from 5–8 m³/h to 21 m³/h and their frames run from 400 kg to 1300 kg. A commercial pipeline that has already left those windows belongs on the electric building ladder, or on a diesel page if the grid is absent.
body.zh: 电动15、电动10系列、农村柴油泵和 4100 印的是农村自建房、小型工地和二次结构。它们的输送量从 5–8 m³/h 到 21 m³/h，机架从 400 kg 到 1300 kg。已经离开这些窗口的商业管路，属于电动建筑梯子；没有电网则属于柴油页。

heading.en: Commercial does not mean a mixing plant

body.en: If the job is to mix and pump in one unit, the published machines are the Integrated Mixer Pump (45 kW + 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 100 m / 300 m) and the diesel mixer. The category text says these are not concrete mixing plants. A commercial building that only needs pipeline placement stays on the trailer-pump pages.
body.zh: 如果工况是一台机器又搅拌又泵送，已公布的是搅拌泵一体机（45 kW + 14 kW、21 m³/h、100 m / 300 m）和柴油搅拌泵。分类说明写明它们不是混凝土搅拌站。只需要管道浇筑的商业建筑，留在拖泵页面。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say “commercial pipeline” only after you have metres, stone and power. Otherwise name the compact window instead. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 有了米数、石子和动力之后，再写“商业管路”。否则请点名紧凑窗口。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: Its own scenario line is building and commercial placement, at 50 m³/h and 120 m horizontal. Long horizontal infrastructure at 900 m is Electric 80.
answer.zh: 它自己的工况句是建筑与商业浇筑，50 m³/h、水平 120 m。900 m 的长水平基建是电动80。

answer.en: No. Mortar, plaster and listed concrete spraying are on /products/spraying-machines.
answer.zh: 不包括。砂浆、石膏和目录中的混凝土喷涂在 /products/spraying-machines。

question.en: Is there a named commercial project?

answer.en: No. The catalogue names the application, not a building.
answer.zh: 没有。目录写的是工况，不是一座楼。
